regime_context: China A-shares show a one-narrative, narrow tape: only two themes are trend-eligible and Coal leads Banks by a thin 0.037 margin, with the absolute-trend gate flagging as did_NOT_hold_here. The detector's own backtest verdict says momentum rank is an attention lens (rank-IC ~0) and the rotation timing is display-only, so this note carries low prior conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Banks (rank 2, crowded) closes the 0.037 margin over Coal AND holds breadth above 0.8 for 10 consecutive sessions — that would be a confirmed leadership handoff, not a prediction.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only eligible theme besides Coal, but it is crowded (z=1.83) and the crowd flag is a size-down caution, not a trigger. The category is Financials & Value with high breadth (0.944), which is positive for durability, yet the mean-reverting tape and the fact that the trend gate did_NOT_hold_here on this market's history mean an 'avoid' lean (stay out rather than chase) is defensible; an overweight needs a fresh absolute-trend confirmation that this detector explicitly withholds.
theses.dissent: Banks has the healthiest durability (0.82) and near-total breadth (0.944) of any eligible theme, and if A-share policy/bond-yield flows favor financials, a crowded but persistent leadership can continue to grind higher for weeks.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms CSI 300 by more than 4% over the next 20 trading days while Coal remains eligible.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the rank-1 leader and the sole one-narrative headline, but its hurst_tag is mean-revert, breadth is just 0.5 (half the eligible universe is not participating), and durability_bar is 0.5 (at the threshold). It is not crowded, but the guardrails forbid treating the leader as a buy because it leads. With the trend gate not helping on this market's history and rank-IC ~0, the honest lean is to avoid adding exposure rather than overweight the leader.
theses.dissent: Coal is the strongest eligible theme by score, not crowded, and in a narrow one-narrative tape the leader can absorb the entire risk budget and keep trending even if breadth is thin.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS gives back all of its 20-day outperformance versus CSI 300 and underperforms by more than 3% over the next 20 trading days.
